verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Honcho serves an llms.txt at honcho.dev/llms.txt (HTTP 200), describing the product for agents and indexing doc pages such as the Mem0 migration guide, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. missing for 10: markdown doc variants (docs.md returned 404), any llms-full.txt or machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all candidate paths 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming the llms.txt.
